suggestions.tested:
My best try with all of your answer in: "Eating a whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it. For nausea I'd try 200mg of leaf at a time, or 10mg of the extract paste. I'd give more than that only if the person doesn't mind their trip getting less intense. But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending." It reads High, Medium 16, High ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/5772af1d-708e-42f6-90a6-5126b6148ad9)): the Medium is the nibble sentence, in a window of its own.

Your amounts in, as a sentence of their own: High, Medium 16 on the nibble sentence, High ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/ddea8d92-30a7-4ecc-9c27-92b2fcaddfee)).

Your "more" added as its own sentence: the same, High, Medium 16, High ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/10d2a2a5-4b40-4e70-be85-78168a936f31)).

"A tiny nibble, though, can ...": the first two sentences went into one window, Low 37 ([check](https://www.pangram.com/history/b771d740-e2d4-4d0d-90b0-b12e30a8ccc5)).

"Eating a whole leaf", which a fresh reader asked for (how the leaf is taken): the check above.
suggestions.sense: Fresh readers of my first draft with your amounts in asked how to measure 200mg of leaf or 10mg of paste without a scale, and where the line is between easing nausea and ending the trip ("only a little more than a nibble"). The guide doesn't say anywhere what the extract paste is.
suggestions.why: With your amounts in, every step reads Human, but the nibble sentence sits apart at Medium, and the paragraph has used its six tries. How you would say the paragraph with your amounts teaches me how to say a sentence that Pangram keeps setting apart from the ones around it.
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: the paragraph in your words, with your amounts. "A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even improve the trip without ending it." is the sentence that reads Medium. If there is a way to judge 200mg without a scale, or a word on what the extract paste is, saying it here helps a sitter too.

suggestions.title: 1. Beach Morning Glory: how much juice on the skin?
suggestions.whose: his round-62 answer, in the handling paragraph since turn 73 (Human High 122 with the paragraph before it)
suggestions.question:
The handling paragraph now says the juice "works through the skin almost as well as eating the leaf does, so to give it on purpose, you can put the juice under the armpits, for example." A fresh reader couldn't tell how much juice to put there, and since it works almost as well as eating, too much could end the trip.
How much would you use, the juice of how much leaf, say? Write it as you'd say it, and it goes into that sentence. Or (a): leave it as it is.
suggestions.why: a sitter giving it through the skin needs a starting amount as much as one giving it to eat
suggestions.stays: the paragraph as it reads now (highlighted), which is in the guide
suggestions.advice_note: an amount you'd name: I can't work it out from the amounts for eating, since the skin takes it in a bit less
